steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8098/ in the browser. If a login form is shown, sign in with username 'admin' and password typed EXACTLY as the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (the environment substitutes the real password when that exact text is typed into the field - do not write anything else, do not try to resolve it yourself). After you are signed in, go to the Assets list and find every asset whose NAME starts with 'Seed:'. For each such asset report its name and its asset tag exactly as displayed. Do not create or modify anything.

02-create: In Snipe-IT, create a new asset with the name '{{runid}} Bench Asset', model 'Bench Laptop Model' (use the searchable model dropdown and pick the matching option from the list - do not create a new model), status 'Ready to Deploy' (choose from the status dropdown), default location 'Bench Office' (choose from the location dropdown), and purchase date 2026-03-15. Save the asset. The asset tag will be auto-assigned by the app - report the asset tag exactly as displayed on the resulting asset page, along with the model, status, location, and purchase date shown. Do not modify any assets whose name starts with 'Seed:'.

03-create: In Snipe-IT, on the asset page for the asset named '{{runid}} Bench Asset' (asset tag {{02-create.asset_tag}}, at {{02-create.asset_page_url}}), perform a Check Out: check the asset out to the user 'Bench Assignee' (choose the user from the searchable dropdown - do not create a new user), and include a note whose text contains '{{runid}}' (for example: 'Checked out for bench run {{runid}}'). Complete the checkout. Then verify on the asset page that the asset is checked out to user 'Bench Assignee' and report the checkout note text and the assignee exactly as displayed. Do not modify any assets whose name starts with 'Seed:'.

04-change: Verification only, do not change anything: open the asset page for the asset named '{{runid}} Bench Asset' (asset tag {{02-create.asset_tag}}, {{02-create.asset_page_url}}) and report exactly what the page displays for: (1) the asset tag, (2) the asset name, (3) the model, (4) the status label, (5) the default location, (6) the purchase date, (7) the user it is checked out to, and (8) the checkout note text from the History tab. Read these from the live page.
